python3 -c "
import cv2
import numpy as np

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0012.png')
# Print color of leg at x=130, y=480:
print('Leg at (130, 480):', img[480, 130])
print('Leg at (255, 480):', img[480, 255]) # floor?
print('Floor at (255, 480):', img[480, 255])
print('Leg at (700? 690?):', img.shape)
# Find the leg pixels below 460:
floor_color = img[500, 255]
print('Floor color:', floor_color)
diff = np.linalg.norm(img[460:, :].astype(float) - floor_color.astype(float), axis=2)
leg_mask = diff > 20
ys, xs = np.where(leg_mask)
print('Non-floor pixels below 460:')
for col_range in [(0, 180), (180, 300), (300, 450), (450, 512)]:
    sub = [(y+460, x) for y, x in zip(ys, xs) if col_range[0] <= x < col_range[1]]
    if sub:
        max_y = max(p[0] for p in sub)
        mean_x = np.mean([p[1] for p in sub if p[0] == max_y])
        print(f'Column range {col_range}: max_y={max_y}, x={mean_x:.1f}')
"
